tasks.short: Estimate labour, material, and construction costs

steps.what: List material and construction quantities from the bill

loop.output: quantity lines each with a source id
loop.check: Each quantity names a line id that exists on the bill
loop.stop: One pass, then leave a blank where no quantity is printed
loop.why_not_simpler: Drawings state quantities in notes, not in one table

steps.what: Extend material costs by the price table
Read the supplier quote total onto the line

loop.input: supplier quote and the matching line ids
loop.output: quote total tied to a quote id
loop.check: The extracted total equals the total printed on that quote
loop.stop: Stop if the quote has no total or no quote id
loop.why_not_simpler: Quote layouts differ, so a fixed column map misses the total

steps.what: Comment on the estimate against the budget
Sign the cost estimate for the budget
File the signed cost estimate

tasks.design: Material and construction quantities land on a {SPREADSHEET} from the bill in {DOCS}. A price table extends each line. A bounded read takes only the printed total from a supplier quote in {EMAIL} and flags a mismatch. The electrical engineer signs one estimate version, and only that version is filed for the budget.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities, old prices, and quote totals lived in separate workbooks and mail, so a total could not be tied to a line.
tasks.enabler_now: A bill of materials can carry a quantity, a unit code, and a source id that a price table can multiply.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a contingency, and trusting a quote that does not match the line, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer accepts a price exception and the contingency, and can refuse an estimate whose quote total does not match.

ambition.what: Refresh the estimate when a quantity changes, not only at the budget gate

tasks.altitude: The week moves from retyping lines to exceptions and the contingency. The engineer can block a line with no quantity.

reach.task: Build the project budget from the signed estimate
reach.learn: Which lines are signed and which quantities are still blank

evidence.claim: In a mid-size firm this estimate is quantities times a price table. The hard part is a missing quantity or a quote that does not match, not the multiplication.
A model should only read a supplier quote. The extracted total has to match the total printed on that quote before the line is used.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when a signed estimate version is filed for the budget. Placing the order is a later task.

Input contract: line id, quantity, unit code, source id, price-list id, quote id, quote total. Producer is the bill of materials and the supplier quote. A line with no quantity stays blank and is typed by the engineer.
Use the spreadsheet price table and the document store's own approval before custom code. Keeping the price table current is counted in incremental hours.
The meeting prior is moderate. Time on this task sits on the workbook and the quote. The controller's check is a short comment, not a workshop.
unknowns: Who may sign an estimate when the engineer is absent.
Whether labour rates come from a rate card or from a payroll export.
research_questions: What share of lines has no quantity on the bill?
How often does the quote total differ from the extended line?

already_counted.description: Engineer corrects quantities the bill did not state clearly
Engineer checks a quote total before using it
Engineer sets the contingency in the sign-off

incremental.description: Keep unit codes and the price table aligned when a new material class appears
Controller time on budget comments stays in s4; chasing a missing quote sits here

approvals.approved_version: cost estimate version signed for this budget
the same signed cost estimate version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many quantities are still only on drawings, so the engineer retypes them and the price table rarely runs. The high case assumes clean lines extend, while every exception and the contingency still take a signature. The purchase is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan the research procedure for an electrical project

steps.what: Read prior tests and the electrical theory
Agree how to apply the electrical theory
Draft the research methodology from those fields

loop.input: agreed fields and the procedure template
loop.output: procedure draft with each figure tagged to a field
loop.check: Every number in the draft equals a submitted field
loop.stop: Leave the section blank and stop if a number has no field
loop.why_not_simpler: Method prose depends on the project, and a fixed merge cannot write it

steps.what: Sign the research procedure version
File the procedure the project will implement

tasks.design: The electrical engineer reads the sources and agrees the question in a meeting. A {DOCS} template drafts the research procedure only from fields the engineer has filled: question, measurement, instrument, sample, and pass rule. A number with no field is left blank. The engineer signs one version, and that version is what the project implements. An untraced figure is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Methods were rewritten as free text, and figures were not tied to a measurement the engineer had named.
tasks.enabler_now: A short field list can feed a procedure template, and each figure can be checked against a field.
tasks.still_hard: A new electrical question does not fit the last procedure, and the reading cannot be skipped.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the question, what to measure, and whether a source is good enough to cite.

ambition.what: Sign a procedure before each new measurement, not only at the project start

tasks.altitude: Less time formatting the procedure. No less time reading or choosing the method. The engineer can refuse a number that has no field.

reach.task: Run only the measurements named on the signed procedure
reach.learn: Which pass rule is signed and which section was left blank

evidence.claim: Most of this task is choosing the question and reading. The part that can move is the written procedure and a blank test log, not the science.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn and its data were not trusted, so an untraced number is not entered as a result of the method.
Digest [S11] says an executable simulation call is not a correct result. If the procedure includes a simulation, it must name the check a person performs.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when a signed procedure is filed for the project to use. Running the experiment is a later task.
Input contract: question, measurement name, instrument id, sample size, pass rule, source note. Producer is the engineer after the reading. If a field is empty the draft leaves that section blank.
Research reading and the method meeting stay with the person. Native templates in the document store are tried before custom code.
Digest [S20] is a warning not to file an untraced figure. It is not a finding of this project.
unknowns: Who else must sign a procedure that leaves the lab.
Whether a simulation log is required for this project or the method is measurement only.
research_questions: How often is a procedure rewritten because a measurement was never defined?
Which projects start work before a procedure is signed?

already_counted.description: Reading time stays with the engineer
Method meeting stays with the engineer
Engineer edits the draft before signing

incremental.description: Revise the procedure template when a new measurement type appears

approvals.approved_version: research procedure version signed for this project
the same signed research procedure version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the method is new each time, so the template rarely fits and the engineer still writes it. The high case assumes the draft matches the fields, but the reading, the meeting, and the signature stay. Running the test is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise and train project team members

steps.what: Prepare the training checklist for this project
Train the project team member on the work
Show the practised project task
Record the skill that was covered
Sign the training coverage note
File the signed coverage note

tasks.design: A {DOCS} checklist names the skill and the project task to practise. The electrical engineer trains the person in the room. Afterwards a {WORKFLOW} note records the skill covered, the date, and who attended. It has no score field. The engineer signs that note. The conversation itself does not move.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coaching lived in the room, and any note was a free-text mail that sometimes read like a judgement on the person.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed checklist can record which skill was covered without asking a model to judge the person.
tasks.still_hard: Whether someone can do the work is a people judgement, and it changes with the task in front of them.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether the person can do the work. That judgement is not written by a system.

ambition.what: File a coverage note after each coaching session, not only at the project end

tasks.altitude: The coaching stays in the room. The engineer gains a filed note of what was practised and can refuse a note that contains a score.

reach.task: Repeat the task that was practised
reach.learn: Which skill was marked covered and which was left off the note

evidence.claim: Supervision and training in a mid-size firm is a conversation. A record can list what was covered. It should not become a score.
Digest [S18] says a solely automated decision about a person is barred, so this note records coverage only and a person decides any consequence.
Digest [S19] says a works council is consulted before a study of presence, behaviour, or performance. This note records the skill covered, not those measures.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task is coaching and a coverage note. Hiring, pay, and the formal performance review are other tasks.

Input contract: team member id, skill id, project task id, covered yes or no, session date. Producer is the engineer. There is no score field. A skill not on the list is written by hand and stays manual.
The conversation stays in person. Native workflow forms are used before custom code. The note is not used to watch presence or output rate.
The meeting-heavy prior matches this task. The coaching itself does not move.
unknowns: Whether a formal performance record must also store the note.
Who may see another person's training note.
Which national consent rule applies if someone later adds time or output measures.
research_questions: How often is the same skill coached again because the note was never filed?
Do current notes contain a score, or only a topic?

already_counted.description: Coaching time stays with the engineer
Sign-off time stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Update the skill checklist when the project type changes

approvals.approved_version: coverage note signed for this session

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes every session is different, so the checklist is rewritten and only the filing is new. The high case assumes the checklist is reused, but the coaching and the signature stay in full. No performance scoring is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist with the capital program for repairs

steps.what: List equipment due for major repair
Attach the signed cost band to each line
Draft the capital program from those lines

loop.input: equipment lines and the program template
loop.output: program draft that cites equipment ids
loop.check: Every equipment id and every cost figure is on the line list
loop.stop: One draft, then drop a sentence that cites no equipment id
loop.why_not_simpler: The case for repair versus replacement is prose, not a lookup

steps.what: Sign the recommended capital program
Accept the capital program for the year
File the accepted capital program

tasks.design: Equipment id, age, failure count, and a repair or replace flag sit on a {PROJECT} list. A {SPREADSHEET} attaches only a cost band that already comes from a signed estimate. The electrical engineer drafts a short case in {DOCS} that may cite those equipment ids and no others. The project controller accepts one year version. This is not an energy filing, and no consumption threshold is applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment condition, cost, and the case for replacement lived in different sheets, so a program could not show which figure it used.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintenance export can carry an equipment id, and a signed estimate can carry a cost band for that id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether to repair or replace is a judgement, and some rows have no age and no failure count.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recommends repair or replacement and can keep an item off the list.

ambition.what: Review the capital list when a major failure is closed, not only once a year

tasks.altitude: Less time copying costs into the program. The same time on what to fund. The engineer can block a line with no equipment id or no signed cost band.

reach.task: Accept or refuse the year program
reach.learn: Which items the engineer recommended and which rows had no cost band

evidence.claim: A capital program in a mid-size firm is a ranked equipment list plus a short case. The rank uses condition and a cost the engineer already signed, not a model score.
The engineer who signs the recommendation stays responsible for it. Filing the list does not move that responsibility.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when an accepted year program is filed. Releasing the money is a later task.

Input contract: equipment id, age years, failure count, repair or replace flag, cost band, source estimate id. Producer is the maintenance record and the signed estimate. A row with no equipment id is not ranked.
Native project lists and the spreadsheet are configured before custom code. The sort uses the signed cost band only.
This is not an energy information report. No consumption threshold is applied as a rule.
unknowns: Who has authority to accept the year program.
Whether safety-critical repairs are forced onto the program by a separate rule.
Which maintenance record is the list of equipment.
research_questions: What share of equipment rows has no age or no failure count?
How often does the accepted program differ from the engineer's recommendation?

already_counted.description: Engineer reviews a thin equipment list
Engineer edits the program case before recommending it
Recommendation time stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Update equipment fields when a new asset class is added to the register
Controller time to reconcile a changed recommendation

approvals.approved_version: recommended capital program for this year
accepted capital program for this year

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the equipment list is incomplete, so the engineer still assembles it and the cost attach rarely runs. The high case assumes lines are complete, but the recommendation and the acceptance meeting stay. Spending approval is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The electrical engineer stops retyping quantities and lesson notes, and keeps the week for cost exceptions, research choices, and the people on the job.
reach: The project controller receives a signed cost estimate instead of a rebuilt workbook.
Project team members get a filed note that names the skill covered, not a score.
skills_to_grow: State a cost line as quantity, unit, and source so a price table can extend it.
Write a research procedure as fields a template can check, and keep the reading.
Record training as the skill that was covered, never as a score.
role.ambitious_version: Each budget has a signed estimate, each new measurement has a signed procedure, and each capital year has an accepted list.
